assumptions: Fresh-process CLI validation is a meaningful minimum recovery test.
Tamper tests cover the highest-impact initial invariant: the zero-exposure Governor snapshot.
expected_outcome: All unit tests, repository-state validation, status, and deterministic next-work selection pass from a fresh Python process.
hypothesis: The minimum file-backed kernel can preserve and validate enough state to resume the autonomous loop without conversation context.
reversal_conditions: Validation cannot detect Governor drift or broken references.
A fresh process cannot identify current state and next work.
Mutation commands leave invalid state.
test_method: Run the unittest suite, validate/status/next-work commands, failure-injection tests, and a fresh-process resume check.

assumptions: Apify Store user/run fields are accurate enough for longitudinal demand proxies.
Search results require manual relevance curation.
Usage does not imply paid use or revenue.
expected_outcome: At least one narrow query will show 20 aggregate 30-day users and one paid competitor with at least 5 users, justifying deeper differentiation and source-access review.
hypothesis: Public Store telemetry can cheaply identify a narrow paid data-product demand gap worth prototyping.
observed_outcome: Initial snapshot succeeded. Business-entity and government-tender queries cleared raw usage thresholds; EU TED cleared them with two paid results over five users. Results are uncurated and do not prove a defensible gap, permitted source, paid conversion, revenue, or margin.
reversal_conditions: Relevant curated telemetry is flat or declining.
Source terms block automation.
No differentiated output survives review.
Plausible volume cannot support USD 100 monthly contribution margin.
test_method: Capture five public Store searches daily for seven days, compare user/run/review/success changes, curate substitutes, and apply the promotion gate.

assumptions: Title-level curation can reject clearly crowded/low-adoption wedges but cannot prove a feature gap.
Current official TED search/reuse documentation governs the source-access research gate.
expected_outcome: Curation will reduce noisy aggregate demand to at most one candidate meeting adoption, competition, source-access, and differentiation gates.
hypothesis: At least one public-data wedge survives initial relevance, competition, and source-access curation.
observed_outcome: EU TED alone passed the numeric gate and has anonymous official API/reuse support, but leaders cover common filtering, flattening, export, and alert use cases at low prices. A defensible output gap and attainable margin remain unproven. Four other queries failed the numeric/competition gate.
reversal_conditions: EU TED usage signal decays.
Feature matrix shows no differentiated high-value event.
Attribution/privacy/third-party rights make the wedge impractical.
Modeled volume cannot support USD 100 monthly contribution margin.
test_method: Manual curation of revision-2 telemetry plus current TED API/reuse rules and leading listing features/prices.

assumptions: Fresh-process local commands are sufficient for bootstrap recovery proof.
External CI execution is not required before a local bootstrap transition; the workflow is configured but unobserved.
expected_outcome: The repository validates durable state, fails closed on policy/evidence drift, recovers interrupted local mutations, selects/resumes work, and executes one real discover-rank-experiment-record-reflect loop.
hypothesis: The minimum kernel is sufficient to exit BOOTSTRAP into evidence-driven DISCOVERY without adding a service/database/deployment.
observed_outcome: Fourteen local tests pass after hardening; validation checks policy, treasury, evidence checksums, references, wallet boundary, ledger, recovery, and resume state. A seven-candidate register and a real read-only experiment with curation, incident handling, metrics, and continuation state exist. CI is configured but not yet run externally.
reversal_conditions: Fresh-process validation/status/recovery fails.
Canonical state diverges after interruption.
Governor or treasury integrity checks fail.
Evidence references or checksums cannot be reconstructed.
test_method: Unittest suite, compileall, validate, clean recovery, status/active-task resume, deterministic next-work, and actual external read-only experiment.

assumptions: Current Store listings and official platform/source documentation materially describe available features and economics.
Public users/runs are demand proxies, not revenue.
expected_outcome: A differentiated EU TED event survives feature and USD 100 monthly contribution gates.
hypothesis: EU TED is a defensible official-data pay-per-event wedge.
observed_outcome: Sixty-one clearly relevant Actors appeared in the first 100 results, including exact delta/award/integrity/report substitutes. Optimistic USD 100 monthly thresholds require 9,329-125,000 billable events before most costs, with no paid-volume evidence.
reversal_conditions: Three independent buyers identify the same unmet workflow and credible volume.
A new official surface creates an uncovered event.
A pre-sale supports measured USD 100 monthly contribution.
test_method: Read-only live Store competition/feature matrix, official source-access review and optimistic unit-economics bounds.

assumptions: Public competitor pages and SEC documentation are current.
expected_outcome: A valuable SEC diff/provenance workflow absent from exact substitutes justifies a local prototype.
hypothesis: Point-in-time SEC filing diffs remain uncommoditized.
observed_outcome: An exact Apify change detector and multiple mature services already provide comparison, extraction, provenance, events and alerts; usage and unit economics do not support a build.
reversal_conditions: Multiple independent buyers identify the same unmet workflow.
A source/schema change creates a new provenance capability.
test_method: Read-only source, substitute, demand and unit-economics review.

assumptions: Public listing adoption/reviews are useful but incomplete demand proxies.
expected_outcome: A repeated permission-minimal catalog workflow is absent from adopted substitutes.
hypothesis: Shopify catalog-quality monitoring has a defensible paid gap.
observed_outcome: Seven adopted substitutes and seven newer exact-purpose apps cover monitoring, rules, anomaly checks, alerts and rollback; no repeated unmet catalog complaint survived.
reversal_conditions: Ten independent merchant reviews repeat an unsolved workflow.
A new uncovered product surface or incumbent withdrawal creates a gap.
test_method: Read-only twelve-listing/review, permission and economics matrix with early stopping.

assumptions: Marketplace installs/reviews and official platform documentation are current.
expected_outcome: A repeated access-review/evidence gap survives direct and native competition with manageable scopes.
hypothesis: Atlassian access evidence has a defensible paid workflow.
observed_outcome: Seven exact substitutes cover the workflow, adjacent competition and native Guard are material, scopes are sensitive, and no review or buyer corpus establishes demand.
reversal_conditions: Three repeated public complaints expose one missing workflow.
An RBAC/API change creates a new capability.
Three qualified buyers pre-commit USD 75/site/month.
test_method: Read-only direct competitor, native substitute, permission/security and economics review.

assumptions: Cantina's current published terms permit automated or semi-automated review.
Completed public scopes and outcomes can support offline benchmarking without account or submission.
expected_outcome: One safely isolated completed-scope replay estimates whether a ten-scope precision/effective-value experiment is worth continuing.
hypothesis: A deterministic security-analysis pipeline can produce nonzero validated unique-finding signal on completed Cantina scopes.
reversal_conditions: Safe isolation cannot be maintained.
First replay produces no useful signal.
Terms or scope access change.
test_method: Offline isolated replay on one completed public scope; no account, submission, wallet, deposit or live testing.

assumptions: Public market data can support initial replay without accounts or capital.
Market activity must be measured directly rather than inferred from 24/7 availability.
Execution costs and fill realism can be modeled conservatively enough to reject weak strategy families.
expected_outcome: At least three strategy families receive comparable after-cost replay evidence across activity and time-of-week regimes, yielding a justified shadow candidate or explicit rejection.
hypothesis: One crypto-market mechanism can retain positive walk-forward net expectancy in identifiable activity regimes after realistic execution costs.
reversal_conditions: No strategy survives costs and robustness checks.
Accessible data cannot support reproducible execution-aware replay.
Venue rules, market structure or Governor authority changes materially.
test_method: Public-data deterministic replay segmented by activity, liquidity, volatility and time-of-week; include fees, spread, slippage, latency, funding, fill probability, failures and infrastructure cost; no live orders or capital.

assumptions: The scenario cost bound is more decision-useful than inventing an unavailable account fee tier.
Candle replay can reject weak strategy families but cannot prove fillable edge.
expected_outcome: At least one family passes the 20 bps per-side promotion gate on both products.
hypothesis: One fixed crypto spot family retains positive out-of-sample net expectancy after conservative costs.
observed_outcome: At 20 bps per side, trend returned BTC -21.84% and ETH -21.61%; mean reversion BTC -24.56% and ETH -24.96%; breakout BTC -5.04% and ETH -11.53%. Weekend gross contribution was negative for every family/product. No family passed.
reversal_conditions: A prospectively timestamped activity filter passes costs on both assets.
A materially different market mechanism, data surface or execution-cost structure produces new evidence.
test_method: Committed preregistered public-data deterministic replay over 34,560 five-minute candles, fixed 60/40 split, next-candle execution, deterministic fill stress and four cost scenarios.

assumptions: The active-weekday concentration may recur prospectively, but the current observation is post-hoc.
Forward shadow decisions can be timestamped and reconciled without trading authority.
expected_outcome: The active-weekday breakout filter either produces positive after-cost expectancy on both products or is rejected after 100 eligible observations or 14 days.
hypothesis: The breakout family has positive prospective net expectancy only during objectively active weekdays.
reversal_conditions: Either product has non-positive net expectancy at the evidence gate.
Timestamping, data integrity or restart recovery fails.
test_method: At each five-minute close, durably record the fixed breakout signal and training-frozen activity condition before the next candle; reconcile at next open with 20 bps per side, no orders or credentials.

assumptions: Local predecessor worktrees are historical evidence, not authoritative dependencies.
Focused unit tests can establish structural behavior but cannot establish economic edge or production safety.
expected_outcome: Predecessor research yields at least one reusable deterministic primitive while unsafe defaults and unearned strategies are rejected.
hypothesis: EPI/Epinnox predecessor work can reduce engineering rediscovery without importing old authority or risk assumptions.
observed_outcome: Thirty focused tests passed across decision contracts, live guards, data-quality gating, and paper execution realism. Data-quality and fail-closed contract concepts merit independent adaptation; MAINNET defaults, strategy edge, uncalibrated fill heuristics, incomplete PnL helpers, and wholesale migration do not qualify.
reversal_conditions: Pinned source hashes change.
Independent adaptation cannot pass current Governor invariants.
A concept lacks a current consumer or measurable benefit.
test_method: Read-only repository/worktree inspection, exact file hashing, focused no-cache tests, and explicit compatibility review against the current Governor.
